name: ZhongHe Shangda Aeronautic Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: ZhongHe Shangda Aeronautic Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of high-temperature and high-performance alloys, ultra-high purity stainless steel, and other special alloy products in China. It operates through two segments: High Temperature and High-Performance Alloys, and High-Quality Special Stainless Steel. It offers iron-based, nickel-based, and cobalt-based alloys, corrosion-resistant, ultra-high-strength, and precision alloys. The company's products are used in gas and steam turbines and nuclear engineering applications, as well as in the petrochemical and aerospace industries.
